guarantees.claim: If lc_escalate_en[0] is MuBi4 true, kmac_st_d is forced to KmacTerminalError ignoring all case-based state transitions.
kmac_state_error is asserted to 1 when kmac_st is KmacTerminalError or any undefined state not in {KmacIdle, KmacPrefix, KmacKeyBlock, KmacMsgFeed, KmacDigest}.
entropy_in_keyblock is set to 1 exactly when kmac_st == KmacKeyBlock, otherwise 0.

assumptions.claim: sha3_absorbed and sha3_done are always valid MuBi4 encoded booleans (no invalid encodings).
assumptions.risk: If corrupted, the FSM may misclassify their true/false values, leading to stalls or incorrect transitions without error escalation.

formal_sketch.consequent: sha3_absorbed and sha3_done are always valid MuBi4 encoded booleans (no invalid encodings)

assumptions.claim: lc_escalate_en[0] is a valid MuBi4 encoded signal; its true value correctly represents a life cycle escalation request.
assumptions.risk: Invalid encoding could suppress or spuriously trigger the escalation override, defeating the security response.

formal_sketch.consequent: lc_escalate_en[0] is a valid MuBi4 encoded signal; its true value correctly represents a life cycle escalation request

uncertain_points.claim: When lc_escalate_en triggers, kmac_st_d is forced to KmacTerminalError, but kmac_state_error is not explicitly set to 1. If the current state is not already KmacTerminalError, kmac_state_error may stay 0.
uncertain_points.risk: Downstream alert logic relying on kmac_state_error may not see the escalation, potentially hiding a security-critical fault.

formal.antecedent: lc_ctrl_pkg::lc_tx_test_true_loose(lc_escalate_en[0]) && !((kmac_st == KmacTerminalError) || !((kmac_st == KmacIdle) || (kmac_st == KmacPrefix) || (kmac_st == KmacKeyBlock) || (kmac_st == KmacMsgFeed) || (kmac_st == KmacDigest)))

formal_sketch.antecedent: lc_ctrl_pkg::lc_tx_test_true_loose(lc_escalate_en[0]) && !((kmac_st == KmacTerminalError) || !((kmac_st == KmacIdle) || (kmac_st == KmacPrefix) || (kmac_st == KmacKeyBlock) || (kmac_st == KmacMsgFeed) || (kmac_st == KmacDigest)))

uncertain_points.claim: Invalid MuBi4 encodings on sha3_absorbed or sha3_done are not explicitly detected; the mubi4_test functions return false for such encodings, potentially stalling the FSM in KmacMsgFeed or KmacDigest without entering the terminal error state.
uncertain_points.cond: sha3_absorbed or sha3_done are invalid MuBi4 values
uncertain_points.risk: A deadlock in the key/absorb path may go undetected, preventing error escalation and possibly exposing key-related operations.

formal_sketch.antecedent: sha3_absorbed or sha3_done are invalid MuBi4 values
formal_sketch.consequent: Invalid MuBi4 encodings on sha3_absorbed or sha3_done are not explicitly detected; the mubi4_test functions return false for such encodings, potentially stalling the FSM in KmacMsgFeed or KmacDigest without entering the terminal error state

security_implications: The FSM controls key block processing (KmacKeyBlock) and responds to life cycle escalation. If kmac_state_error is not forced during escalation, downstream alerting may miss the escalation event, undermining the integrity of the error-handling path. Invalid MuBi4 signals on sha3_absorbed/done could stall the FSM without error reporting, potentially causing a deadlock in key-related operations.
